cohort: 6549 women in routine antenatal care in Belgium, Iceland, Denmark, Estonia, Norway, or Sweden
finding: While preference for cesarean section was associated with fear of childbirth, negative birth experience, and depressive symptoms, the majority of cesareans performed were for medical indications.
mod_finding: 70.8% of women who preferred a cesarean section ultimately delivered by cesarean section.
country: Belgium, Iceland, Denmark, Estonia, Norway, Sweden
